newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent down in slight volume, NYMEX off.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent down in slight volume, NYMEX off.

text.p: SIMEX Brent November futures prices fell in slight trade on Thursday, following the NYMEX trend in the absence of fresh news.
November traded 13 lots by late afternoon to stand at $22.24 per barrel, down seven cents from London's close on Wednesday of $22.31.
NYMEX November crude oil, which rose 59 cents to $23.48 in New York on Wednesday, was last traded at $23.44 but was bid at $23.38 on the overnight ACCESS system.
October was last traded at $23.76, down from the $23.89 close in New York.

Brokers said there was an absence of fresh news to offer the market direction and attributed the fall to a retracement of Wednesday's rally. But they said U.S. stock data this week would remain supportive of the market.
Both EIA data on Wednesday and API data on Tuesday estimated distillate stocks at just more than 112 million barrels, which API said was 21.469 million barrels down on the year before.
NYMEX October heating oil, which rose in New York 2.28 cents to 67.87 cents per gallon, fell back on ACCESS to a last trade of 67.75 and a bid of 67.65.
